title: 第4章
content_zh: 第4章 孤儿院有麻烦晚饭的时候，孤儿院所有的孩子全部都聚在了一起，楚子风的年纪在所有孤儿中是最大的，所以平日里都很痛爱这些弟弟妹妹，就算是以前身体不好的时候，见到弟弟妹妹被别人欺负，楚子风都会第一时间站出来，为弟弟妹妹们出头。“子风哥哥，听李院长说，你这三个月跑到田里干活去了，一定很辛苦吧，这块红烧肉给你吃。”饭厅内，一个十岁左右的小男孩将碗里的一块大红烧肉夹给了旁边的楚子风，脸上那天真无邪的笑容着实令人喜欢，真不知道他的父母是怎么想的，一个这么可爱的孩子，说不要就不要了。“小明真乖，不过子风哥哥不辛苦，你正是长身体的时候，还是自己吃吧。”楚子风将红烧肉夹回给了小男孩，并且还将自己碗中的菜也都夹给了他。“子风哥哥，你的身体不好，以后就不要再去田里干活了。”在楚子风对面，一个可爱的小女孩满嘴油说道。“小丽，子风哥哥没事了，你瞧，子风哥哥的身体可比以前棒多了。”“子风哥哥，听说你这两天就要去读大学了，能不能也带我去呀？”“哈哈，小蛮乖，只要你好好学习，以后也能跟子风哥哥一样去上大学的。”看着这些弟弟妹妹，楚子风一时间还真不想离开这里了，自己在这里生活了十八年的时间，想到过两天就要去燕京了，这心里还真不是个滋味，最重要的是，楚子风舍不得这里的所有人！“李院长，他们又来了。”就在这个时候，一个四十岁左右的妇人从饭厅外跑了进来，看样子非常急。李院长此刻的脸色也变的很难看，从楚子风旁边的饭桌上站起身来，也不知道对那妇人说了什么话，然后就朝饭厅外走去。楚子风觉得事情有点不对劲，李院长以前可从没出现过这样的表情，难道是出了什么事吗？“红姨，你刚才说什么人又来了？”楚子风走上前问道。红姨是孤儿院的工作人员，专门照顾那些十岁以下的孩子，在孤儿院算是保姆的职责。红姨看了看外面，本来她是不想让孩子们知道这件事的，可楚子风已经成年了，又是这群孩子的头，有些事情也可以自己拿注意了，于是说道：“子风，事情是这样的。在院长过世后，他的侄子刘虎就找上了李院长，说是想买下我们孤儿院这块地，用来建筑别墅！可李院长死都不肯卖，所以刘虎就威胁李院长，说如果不卖的话，就天天来捣乱。”红姨刚说完，就听外面一个男人的声音说道：“李爽，你说你整天守在这个破地方有什么意思呢，到头来还不是跟我那死鬼叔叔一样，连口像样的棺材都没有！”“不管你怎么说，出多高的价钱，我都不会卖这块地的。这里是我的家，也是所有孩子的家，我不能让你们把我们的家给毁了。”李院长一副不示弱的态度面对着一个四十岁左右的胖子，这胖子穿着花衬衫，戴着副墨镜，手里抱着只波斯猫，还抽着大雪茄，彻头彻尾的混混样，他就是过世院长的侄子，刘虎。在刘虎的身后还站着四五个男人，每一个都是流里流气的样子。“李爽，看样子今天不给你点苦头吃，你是不知道鲜血为什么那样红。”刘虎对身后的一个小平头挥了挥手，小平头一脸的嚣张，双拳握的“咔咔”作响，就要上前朝李院长挥拳。“住手。”楚子风这个时候从饭厅内冲到了李院长的身前，面对刘虎他们一伙人。“子风，你出来做什么！”楚子风对刘虎大声道：“我们这里的人都很善良，不会跟你们动手，可如果你们敢乱来的话我就报警。”“哎呀，小子，你还挺带种的，敢情你们这孤儿院全部都是硬骨头呀。”小平头说道。“瘦子，先退下，这小子说的没错，现在大白天的不好乱来，就算要动手，那也要等到晚上。”“老板您说的对，我差点给忘记了，现在还是大白天，就先放他们一马！”在小平头回到刘虎身后时，刘虎往旁边吐了口唾液，对李院长说道：“李爽，今天我就不跟你玩了，不过我警告你，我的耐心可是有限的，如果你宁顽不灵的话，就准备给这孤儿院的小子收尸吧。”丢下一句狠话，刘虎带着小平头他们几个转身离去，也不去理会楚子风。“李院长，这到底是怎么回事？为什么连院长的家人都不提买地的事，他的侄子倒是来找麻烦？”李院长深深叹了口气，说道：“其实院长在世的时候这个刘虎就找院长说过这件事，可当时被院长给骂走了！没想到院长刚一过世，刘虎又找上门来了，还使出了那些流氓的手段！”楚子风以前也听说过院长有个侄子是个不干净的主，专干那些杀人放火的勾当，却因为跟市里某个领导的关系好，到现在也没被抓，可没想到，那个刘虎现在居然干起了地产行业，还打起孤儿院的注意来了，想要强买强卖！楚子风问道：“李院长，那你打算怎么办？”“还能怎么办，孤儿院是院长一生的心血，不管怎么样我都不会卖的，如果他们要硬来的话，就只好报警了。”楚子风清楚的知道，如果报警有用的话，那些家伙就不会找上门来了，估计他们在警察局也有人！“李院长，你不用担心，他们也只是吓吓我们而已，不敢乱来的。”楚子风的心中已经产生了怒意，这里是自己的家，如果有人敢动自己的家跟自己家人的话，那自己就要让他付出惨重的代价。李院长邹着眉头说道：“希望如此吧！”这个时候，所有的孩子都已经站在了饭厅外面，一个个嘟着小嘴看着李院长，这些孩子虽然小，但却是人小鬼大，估计已经知道了孤儿院有麻烦。为了不让孩子们担心，李院长强笑出来，说道：“大家都吃完了吗？如果吃完了的话就去做功课，今天晚上我可是要考你们的哦。”看着李院长强颜欢笑，楚子风心道：“李院长，现在要你一个人承担这么大的压力相信也不是院长想看到的，我身为这个大家庭的一份子，也应该帮你分担一下了，希望你跟院长的在天之灵不会怪我这样做！”
content_en: Chapter 4 Trouble in the Orphanage During dinner, all the children in the orphanage gathered together. Chu Zifeng was the oldest among all the orphans, so he loved his younger brothers and sisters very much. Even when he was not in good health in the past, when he saw his younger siblings being bullied by others, Chu Zifeng would immediately stand up and stand up for his younger siblings. "Brother Zifeng, I heard from Dean Li that you have been working in the fields for the past three months. It must have been very hard. I'll give you this piece of braised pork." In the dining room, a little boy of about ten years old gave a large piece of braised pork in the bowl to Chu Zifeng next to him. The innocent smile on his face was really endearing. I really don't know what his parents were thinking. Such a cute child would just say no to him. "Xiao Ming is so good, but brother Zifeng is not working hard. It's time for you to grow, so you should eat it by yourself." Chu Zifeng gave the braised pork back to the little boy, and also gave him all the vegetables in his bowl. "Brother Zifeng, your health is not good. Please don't work in the fields anymore." Opposite Chu Zifeng, a cute little girl said with a glib mouth. "Xiao Li, brother Zifeng is fine. You see, brother Zifeng's health is much better than before." "Brother Zifeng, I heard that you are going to college in the next two days. Can you take me with you?" "Haha, little boy, as long as you study hard, you can be like brother Zifeng in the future. Going to college." Looking at these younger brothers and sisters, Chu Zifeng really didn't want to leave here. He has lived here for eighteen years, and the thought of going to Yanjing in two days really makes him feel uncomfortable. The most important thing is that Chu Zifeng can't bear to leave everyone here! "Dean Li, they are here again." At this moment, a woman about forty years old ran in from the dining room, looking very anxious. Dean Li's face also turned ugly at this moment. He stood up from the dining table next to Chu Zifeng. He didn't know what he said to the woman, and then walked out of the dining room. Chu Zifeng felt that something was wrong. Dean Li had never shown such an expression before. Could something have happened? "Aunt Hong, did you just say that someone is here again?" Chu Zifeng stepped forward and asked. Aunt Hong is a staff member of the orphanage. She specializes in taking care of children under ten years old. She is a nanny in the orphanage. Aunt Hong looked outside. Originally, she didn't want the children to know about this, but Chu Zifeng was already an adult and the leader of the group of children. She could take care of some things by herself, so she said, "Zifeng, the thing is like this. After the dean passed away, his nephew Liu Hu came to find him. He told Director Li that he wanted to buy the land of our orphanage to build a villa! But Director Li refused to sell it, so Liu Hu threatened Director Li that if he didn't sell it, he would come to make trouble every day." As soon as Aunt Hong finished speaking, she heard a man's voice outside say: "Li Shuang, you said you. What's the point of staying in this shabby place all day? In the end, it won't be like my damn uncle, who doesn't even have a decent coffin!" "No matter what you say, no matter how high the price is, I will never sell this land. This is my home and the home of all my children. I can't let you. They destroyed our home." Dean Li faced a fat man about forty years old with an attitude of not showing any weakness. This fat man was wearing a floral shirt and a pair of sunglasses, holding a Persian cat in his hand, and smoking a big cigar. He looked like a complete gangster. He was Liu Hu, the nephew of the deceased president. There were four or five men standing behind Liu Hu, each of them looking angry. "Li Shuang, it seems that if I don't give you something to suffer today, you don't know why the blood is so red." Liu Hu waved his hand to a little crew chief behind him. The little crew chief had an arrogant look on his face, clenched his fists with a "click" sound, and was about to step forward and punch Dean Li. "Stop." Chu Zifeng rushed to Dean Li from the dining room at this time, facing Liu Hu and his group. "Zifeng, what are you doing out here!" Chu Zifeng shouted to Liu Hu: "The people here are very kind and won't do anything to you, but if you dare to mess around, I will call the police." "Oh, boy, you are quite smart. I bet you are all hard-core in this orphanage." Xiao Pingtou said. "Skinny man, step back first. This kid is right. It's not easy to mess around in broad daylight. Even if you want to take action, you have to wait until night." "Boss, you're right. I almost forgot. It's still broad daylight, so let them go first!" When Xiao Pingtou returned behind Liu Hu, Liu Hu spat aside. , said to Dean Li: "Li Shuang, I won't play with you today, but I'm warning you, my patience is limited. If you are stubborn, prepare to collect the body of this boy from the orphanage." With a harsh word, Liu Hu turned around and left with Xiao Pingtou and the others, ignoring Chu Zifeng. "Dean Li, what's going on? Why didn't even the dean's family mention the purchase of land, but his nephew came to cause trouble?" Dean Li sighed deeply and said: "Actually, Liu Hu told the dean about this when he was still alive, but he was scolded by the dean at that time! Unexpectedly, as soon as the dean passed away, Liu Hu came to visit again, He also used those gangster methods!" Chu Zifeng had heard before that the dean's nephew was an unclean master who specialized in murders and arson. However, because of his good relationship with a certain leader in the city, he has not been caught yet. However, he did not expect that Liu Hu was now engaged in the real estate industry, and he also attracted the attention of the orphanage and wanted to buy and sell by force!
